numeric_representation: All mathematical integers, words, limbs, results and full-product values are canonical nonnegative decimal JSON strings; word_bits and array indices are small JSON integers; bit carries/borrows are JSON booleans. No f64.
case_order: input cases in declared order, then word_bits32,64 for each case
component_grid: add/sub every one ofN=128/b limbs; mul every ordered NxN word pair, a_index outer then bv_index; preserve zeros
full_mul_arrays: lowN limbs weights2^(b*i), highN weights2^(128+b*i), little_endian_256 exactly2N limbs low thenhigh; no truncation/filtering
mul_accumulate_carry_type: whole word MulCarry32/64, decimal string, distinct from bool CarryBit/BorrowBit
not_observed_serializer: Independent QA data contract only; Rust literal consumer makes direct typed assertions, no author serializer assumed
proposed_registration: inside word_arithmetic module: #[cfg(test)] #[path="word_arithmetic_independent_normal_tests.rs"] mod independent_normal_tests; Root integration only
